command: set -e; SDK="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; printf '%s\n' '--- system-images tree ---'; find "$SDK/system-images" -maxdepth 5 -type f -o -type l 2>/dev/null | head -100; printf '%s\n' '--- package metadata ---'; find "$SDK/system-images" -name package.xml -o -name source.properties 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '1,80p' "$f"; done
